author: Bay State News
title: Fraser Minten receives NESN's 7th Player Award for 2025-26 season
text:
Fraser Minten has been named the winner of NESN’s 7th Player Award for the 2025-26 season, according to an announcement on Apr. 14. The award is determined by fan votes online at NESN.com and is given to the Boston Bruins player who exceeded fans’ expectations during the season.
The recognition highlights Minten’s performance over his rookie campaign, where he appeared in 81 games and achieved career highs with 17 goals, 17 assists, and a total of 34 points. The 21-year-old leads all National Hockey League rookies in plus-minus with a +20 rating. He also ranks among the top ten NHL rookies in several categories: tied for seventh in goals, tied for ninth in points, third in even strength goals (16), ninth in even strength points (30), and tied for first with two overtime goals.
Minten was previously named NHL Rookie of the Month for January after leading all rookies that month with eight goals and tying for first place league-wide with fourteen points. His achievements this season include scoring his first career overtime goal as well as his first shootout goal.
As part of receiving the award, Minten will be presented with a trophy and $5,000 to donate to a charity of his choice. He has chosen Home for Little Wanderers as this year’s beneficiary.
Previous winners of NESN’s 7th Player Award who are currently on the Bruins roster include Morgan Geekie (2025), Pavel Zacha (2023), Jeremy Swayman (2022), Charlie McAvoy (2018), and David Pastrnak (2015 and 2017).
The continued tradition of honoring players who exceed expectations reflects both fan engagement and recognition within the team.
